answer: Each identity must moor one boat in a harbor, and the k-th boat must chart the k-th central Delannoy number of prism channels: the first charts 3, the second 13, the third 63, the fourth 321. Ten boats chart 9,885,456 channels and the tenth alone 8,097,453. Each boat waits one tide per earlier boat before its orchard cargo unloads, so the hundredth fake waits 99 tides.
